## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.17.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.17.1.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.17.1.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.17.1.

## What's new

- **Accuracy pass on everything written.** Both manuals, the in-game Guide,
  the playtest README and the developer docs were checked line by line
  against the game's code:
  - defence cards now say what they do: they work the same in every area of
    your own mind (the card tooltip, the Field Manual and the quick reference
    no longer claim an area bonus that the rules never applied);
  - the Field Manual lists all seven technologies the campaigns use, says
    that Frame the Story also makes the next push 40% stronger, that the
    extra-move button needs at least 4 points, that captured nodes do not
    drift back on their own, and that Recruit gives the opponent 2 fewer
    points a turn;
  - the Practitioner's Manual describes the "Who decided better" verdict
    correctly (average Decision Health), notes that Show of Force has no
    audience roll, that only the built-in campaigns double the last crisis,
    and how the budget cap works;
  - White Cell notices: Blue sees them before its turn, Red when Blue's code
    arrives (the manuals and the console now say so);
  - credits now say that 16 of the 18 technology score sets are the
    designer's estimates.
- **Fixes in the game's text.** The debrief chart names Donovia in Donovia
  campaigns (it always said Olvana). Blue's free press makes Official
  Statements 60% stronger while Trust holds, not 25% as the opponent page
  said.
- **Playtest README** (in every download): the right file and button names,
  and new sections on structured sessions and Immersive Briefings.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.17 builds.
